summary.intent: Execute and ship CipherBox GSD phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration): wire the v2.0 web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain, replacing 46 runtime stubs, with the full tests/web-e2e Playwright suite passing, then run the complete post-execution ship-phase loop (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit review, PR).
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 executed across 33 plans and 3 gap-closure rounds, reaching e2e tallies from 6/208 to 205/208 passing (2 failures being explicit human-approved deferrals), with round-3 verification PASSED 5/5. Ship-phase then found and fixed a real production write-plane clobber bug (CAS-merge dropping concurrent WriteChildRefs on 409 conflicts) via CodeRabbit review, restored 9 quarantined sdk-e2e suites to 100/101 passing, deleted dead code, and applied 12 web-side security/correctness fixes, with the PR not yet opened at transcript end.

repo: CipherBox node/v3: write-plane (WriteChildRef, keyed by node UUID childId, NOT ipnsName) is separate from read-plane (SealedChildRef, keyed by ipnsName); confusing the two handles caused multiple bugs (move re-homing, sdk-e2e test failures).

getWriteBodyParams fail-opens to {} on zero writeKey (D-03) — intentional, but a transient IPNS resolve miss on an already-write-capable folder also returns writeChildren:[], risking an empty write-body republish (documented as latent risk, not fixed).

createFolder must self-register subfolders via registerFolder with a real writeKey; manually re-calling registerFolder after createFolder (old sdk-e2e test pattern) clobbers the writeKey with zeros and trips the D-06 'nodeId is required' guard.
TEE republish enrollment requires BOTH encryptedIpnsPrivateKey AND keyEpoch on POST /ipns/publish or nothing gets scheduled for republish (durable-registration gap).

mock-ipns-routing (dev delegated-routing mock on :3001) keeps records in an in-memory Map — wiped on every restart; only records with a DB row (ipns_records table, written synchronously at publish) survive.
mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used busybox wget against 'localhost' which resolves to ::1 while the app is IPv4-only — fixed to 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml.
API listens on :3000, not :3001 — :3001 is the delegated-routing mock, a common source of misdirected health probes.

recovery.html (last touched Phase 24) only accepts legacy v2 single-key vault blobs and v2 metadata; the app has produced v3/node-v3 since Phase 62 — recovery flow is broken for any v3 account (deferred as its own todo).

dfsFindFolder previously unconditionally re-resolved and overwrote every intermediate ancestor's folderTree entry on every call, contradicting its own 'cheap on later calls' docstring — fixed with a cache short-circuit that reuses already-cached write-capable entries.

shares/invites REST API grants an entire subtree with one ECIES wrap of the root readKey — there is no server-side per-child key field; collectChildKeys (built to the old per-child-key spec) has no live caller.
SharedWriteContext has no ipnsPrivateKey field — shared-write ops derive the publish key from inside the unsealed write-body, so subfolder writes only need writeKey, not key recovery.

shares table's plaintext item_name column was dropped entirely (not renamed) by migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover, making the REQ-4 itemName backfill permanently dead code under the zero-knowledge rule (GAP-6) — required a product decision to retire+redesign as encrypted.

CI's unit-test job only runs coverage for api, crypto, core, sdk-core, sdk, api-client — it does NOT run @cipherbox/web unit tests at all (web is covered by Playwright web-e2e only), so a broken web unit test file (ipns.service.test.ts, missing createAxiosInstance in its mock) can sit broken on main without CI going red.
decision-coverage gate parser requires the colon INSIDE the bold markdown group: '- **D-04 [informational]:**' not '- **D-04:** [informational]' — tag placement outside the bold group fails to parse.

code.finding: createFolder's reconcileFolderSequence throws ReconcileStaleError before any key-mint/publish/insert side effects, so useMutationFailureUx's retry-on-stale is safe to retry cleanly (CodeRabbit finding 13, correctly ruled invalid).

publishWithCas's decodeRemote only unsealed the remote read-body on a 409 conflict; the write-body was resealed with the original closure's stale writeChildren, silently dropping a concurrent writer's WriteChildRef on merge — fixed by unsealing the remote write-body and unioning writeChildren by childId (remote wins, add-only union).

moveItem previously left the moved child's WriteChildRef orphaned in the source write-body while relinking only the read-plane SealedChildRef, permanently breaking edit/save after move — fixed by unsealing under source writeKey, dropping from source, resealing under dest writeKey, keyed by the resolved node UUID (childPub.id, not the ipnsName-based childId param).

subscribeToSdk's folder-event handler needed a hybrid sync/async kind-cache resolution: synchronous insert only when every child's kind is already cached, else await resolveKinds with a stale-sequence guard — fixes the D-02 owner-side kind-cache race that blocked writable-shares 10.4.
Hardcoded isFolder = true meant the kind cache populated by 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser, so files were always rendered/treated as folders — fixed to isFolder = !isFileRef(item).

workflow: Background agents launching long-running suites (full 208-spec Playwright runs, ~20-25min) frequently 'lose their wake' — the completion notification fires but the agent's session was already evicted; recovery pattern is: independent disk-based watchdog + SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm, or a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed_state if evicted.

When multiple background agents die simultaneously on account/session limits, verify actual disk state (git diff, git log) before trusting any in-flight work rather than assuming total loss or total completion.
CodeRabbit CLI hits a 150-file diff limit; large phase diffs (179 files) must be split into directory-scoped review passes.

For destructive commands like git stash, executor subagents violating a 'no git stash' hard rule happened twice in this session — both self-caught and recovered without data loss, but the rule needs stronger enforcement.
1Password gpg-signing commit timeouts (exit 143) are known false negatives — always verify with `git log -1` before retrying rather than blind-retrying (would risk duplicate commits).

Playwright's describe.serial per spec file means a suite-wide failure count can badly understate real breakage — failures early in a serial file mask 'not run' tests downstream that would have failed too; always disposition via targeted single-file re-runs, not just the aggregate tally.

Live full-stack manual testing by the user caught 3 real bugs (cold-load subfolder nav, text-editor decryption, move-then-edit write loss) that automated e2e coverage structurally could not reach because serial-abort shadowed the deeper test steps — 'green suite' does not mean 'every path exercised'.

Ground-truth verification protocol for a background agent's claimed 'no changes' or partial work: check git diff/git log directly rather than trusting the agent's self-report, especially after a forced session-limit kill.

friction: Wave-1 executor stalled mid-stream ('Response stalled mid-stream') requiring spot-check + SendMessage resume.

Exit-gate agent lost its wake after launching the background e2e suite — happened repeatedly (at least 3 times) across different rounds; disk watchdog based on .last-run.json mtime failed once because that playwright config never writes it.
Multiple session-limit deaths mid-execution (planner, two ship-phase fix agents) requiring inline recovery: validating partial disk state, completing unfinished edits, and continuing.
git index.lock contention on a tracking commit (transient, resolved on retry after verifying no partial commit).
gsd-tools check subcommand name mismatch: 'tdd-gate' doesn't exist, correct name is 'tdd-review-checkpoint'.
Decision-coverage gate parser initially failed twice on bullet/tag formatting before the correct placement (colon inside bold group) was found.
68.1-21 agent misreported its own worktree's expected_base (its own HEAD instead of the fork point), requiring manual git merge-base verification before recording.
Two separate executor subagents ran the forbidden git stash command mid-task, requiring self-caught recovery.

sdk-e2e suite had 89 skipped tests hiding an entire quarantined v2→v3 test-modernization backlog (9 suites, ~52 test-shape failures) that wasn't surfaced until ship-phase's SDK E2E gate step forced a real look.
CodeRabbit CLI's 150-file limit forced a slower, split-by-directory review workflow.
A pre-existing broken web unit test (ipns.service.test.ts) required investigation to prove it was pre-existing (byte-identical to origin/main) and non-CI-gating before it could be safely left alone.
Fable model ran out of usage credits mid-session, forcing a switch to Opus 4.8 mid-flight.

rotation-durability SC-4: API's DB-canonical resolve makes the relay-replay simulation unreachable — needs an apps/api architectural decision or test redesign (deferred).
restore-to-different-parent (bin restore into a folder other than the original) shares the move-orphaned-WriteChildRef bug class fixed in 68.1-31, but is unshipped/unreached — deferred as a todo.

Re-enable/rework the quarantined sdk-e2e suites' underlying assumptions were fixed this ship-phase session (100/101 passing) but a todo was written before that fix completed — verify todo is now stale/closed.

getWriteBodyParams transient IPNS-resolve-miss can drop the entire write chain (writeChildren: []) on an already write-capable folder — flagged as latent risk, not fixed, needs holistic decision across both bin and client.ts copies.
Delete should drop WriteChildRef rather than just retain it indefinitely (write-chain growth, not data loss, but should land per original 68.1-02 deferral).
Rename ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted to encryptedIpnsPrivateKey for consistency — blocked by ~30 fixtures in forbidden test dirs referencing the old name.
Fix broken ipns.service.test.ts unit test mock (missing createAxiosInstance) — pre-existing, non-CI-gating, captured as a todo.
